3.  24-55066  Recommendation to receive and file a report from current Ad Hoc Committees;
  discuss anticipated Ad Hoc Committees for upcoming projects; and, if appropriate,
  take action to dissolve or create Ad Hoc Committees.

  A motion was made by Commissioner Koll, seconded by Commissioner
  Samé-Weil, to approve recommendation, as amended, to [1] dissolve the Ad
  Hoc Committee on Homelessness; [2] add the following members to the
  Institutional Barriers Ad Hoc Committee: Commissioner McNeill and
  Commissioner Shaw-Malone; [3] add Commissioner De Leon to the Equity
  Impact Statements Ad Hoc Committee; [4] add Commissioner Samé-Weil to
  the LGBTQ and BIPOC Ad Hoc Committee; and [5] create the Environmental
  Justice Ad Hoc Committee with the following members: Commissioner De
  Leon, Commissioner Koll, and Vice Chair Batts. The motion carried by the
  following vote:

  Yes:  13 Butler, De Leon, Gillette, Kan, Koll, Lissette Flores, McNeill,
  Montgomery, Samé-Weil, Schultz, Shaw-Malone, Batts, Covington
